2609.16912.title: Lit3R: Retrieve-Relate-Read for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Scientific Literature
2609.16912.paper_summary: We describe tus-nlp's Lit3R (Retrieve-Relate-Read) system for LitTraceQA, a shared task for literature-grounded question answering that requires systems to retrieve relevant papers, identify supporting evidence, and generate answers. Lit3R combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) components without task-specific training. The retriever iteratively combines BM25-based sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based verification, and complements retrieval based on the question with paper-to-paper expansion. The reader first identifies supporting evidence within individual papers and then synthesizes evidence across papers to produce the final answer and evidence trace. On the official test set, our system ranked 4th on the leaderboard. Our code is available at https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa.
2609.16912.paper_summary_zh: 我們描述了 tus-nlp 的 Lit3R（檢索-關聯-閱讀）系統，用於 LitTraceQA，這是一個文獻基礎的問題回答共享任務，要求系統檢索相關論文、識別支持證據並生成答案。Lit3R 結合了現成的檢索、重排序和大型語言模型（LLM）組件，而不需要特定於任務的訓練。檢索器迭代地結合了基於 BM25 的稀疏和密集檢索、交叉編碼器重排序以及基於 LLM 的驗證，並根據問題補充論文之間的擴展。讀者首先在各個論文中識別支持證據，然後綜合各論文的證據以產生最終答案和證據追蹤。在官方測試集中，我們的系統在排行榜上排名第四。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa 獲得。
